iteration.objective: Development net return subject to minimum samples, profit factor >=1.2 and drawdown <=10%; no guarantee of maximum profit.
iteration.caveat: Same ETF subset and repeated historical holdout views; no blind prospective validation. Approval-gated paper fills differ from automatic historical replay.

limitations: Fixed current ETF universe, not full-market or crypto validation; universe selection still subjective.
